title: Adam submits his first report
detail: Adam submitted a report compiling existing information on education in Bengal before proceeding with local inquiry.

title: Macaulay submits his education Minute
detail: Macaulay argued for using government education funds to promote European literature and science through English. Banglapedia places the Minute within the Orientalist–Anglicist dispute.

title: Bentinck issues an education resolution
detail: Banglapedia says Bentinck’s resolution confirmed the Anglicist direction.

title: Adam appointed to investigate education in Bengal
detail: Adam records that the Governor-General in Council appointed him to inquire into native education in Bengal.

title: Adam submits his third report
detail: Adam’s third report presented survey findings from selected Bengal and Behar localities and proposed measures to improve and extend public instruction.
